items.title: Learning Software Architecture
items.author: surprisetalk
items.summary: Software architecture courses teach system design principles, architectural patterns, and scalability strategies. Key skills include software architecture, unified modeling, and systems design. These courses help in making informed architectural decisions and effective system design.

items.title: Postmortem: TanStack NPM supply-chain compromise
items.author: varunsharma07
items.summary: On May 11, 2026, an attacker compromised 42 @tanstack/ packages in an npm supply chain attack. No npm tokens were stolen, but credentials from affected systems should be rotated. The attack was detected and mitigated.

items.title: They Live (1988) inspired Adblocker
items.author: tokenburner
items.summary: They Live (1988) inspired the creation of Adblock Plus, a popular ad-blocking software. The film's satirical depiction of ads influenced the development of tools to block online advertisements.

items.title: If AI writes your code, why use Python?
items.author: indigodaddy
items.summary: Python remains popular for AI due to its simplicity, readability, and extensive libraries for machine learning and data processing. Despite AI writing code, human oversight is crucial for maintainability and long-term project alignment. Python's ecosystem supports diverse AI applications effectively.

items.title: UCLA discovers first stroke rehabilitation drug to repair brain damage (2025)
items.author: bookofjoe
items.summary: UCLA researchers developed DDL-920, a drug that mimics stroke rehabilitation effects in mice, potentially offering a new treatment for stroke recovery. Human trials are planned, aiming to provide a molecular alternative to physical rehabilitation. This breakthrough could significantly improve outcomes for stroke patients.

items.title: Claude Platform on AWS
items.author: matrixhelix
items.summary: The Claude Platform on AWS offers Anthropic's native capabilities through AWS infrastructure, with unified billing and access controls. It provides secure, operator-free API access for sensitive applications. As of 2026, it's available in multiple AWS regions.

items.title: Extremely Low Frequencies
items.author: pinewurst
items.summary: Extremely low frequency (ELF) refers to electromagnetic radiation with frequencies from 3 to 30 Hz. ELF is used in military communications and is considered non-ionizing radiation. ELF fields can affect health, but exposure limits are set to prevent adverse effects.

items.title: Software Internals Book Club
items.author: aragonite
items.summary: The Software Internals Book Club focuses on high-quality books about databases, distributed systems, and software performance, with over 2,500 members worldwide. Discussions are led by experienced members, and each chapter is summarized in an email to spark conversation. The club targets senior developers but welcomes all.

items.title: Google says criminal hackers used AI to find a major software flaw
items.author: donohoe
items.summary: Criminal hackers used AI to find and exploit a major software flaw, marking a significant shift in hacking tactics. This represents the first known case of attackers using AI to independently identify and weaponize a new vulnerability. Google warns this trend is likely to grow.

items.title: I let AI build a tool to help me figure out what was waking me up at night
items.author: showmypost
items.summary: AI can analyze sleep patterns and suggest improvements, helping identify nighttime disturbances and offering personalized routines for better rest.

items.title: Nullsoft, 1997-2004 (2004)
items.author: downbad_
items.summary: Nullsoft, founded in 1997, created the Winamp player and was acquired by AOL in 1999; it was dissolved in 2004. Its notable projects included the MP3 player and Shoutcast server.

items.title: Interaction Models
items.author: smhx
items.summary: Interaction models incorporate both predictors and their product terms, enhancing predictive accuracy. In UX, they define how a product behaves based on user actions to ensure a seamless experience. They are foundational design patterns that guide user interactions.

items.title: Show HN: TikTok but for scientific papers
items.author: ciwrl
items.summary: ArTok is a platform that mimics TikTok for scientific papers, offering a random feed without recommendation algorithms. It aims to diversify paper exploration. The project was showcased on Hacker News in 2025.

items.title: Words Fail (2020)
items.author: surprisetalk
items.summary: "Words Fail" is a song from the 2020 musical "Dear Evan Hansen," performed by Ben Platt. It is featured on the soundtrack and available on Spotify and YouTube. The song was written by Benj Pasek and Justin Paul.

items.title: Interfaze: A new model architecture built for high accuracy at scale
items.author: yoeven
items.summary: Interfaze is a new AI model architecture designed for high accuracy in tasks like OCR, web scraping, and classification. It combines DNN/CNN models with LLMs for deterministic outputs. It offers a chat completion API and programmable guardrails for safety.

items.title: Training an LLM in Swift, Part 1: Taking matrix mult from Gflop/s to Tflop/s
items.author: zdw
items.summary: Training a large language model in Swift involves optimizing matrix multiplication from Gflop/s to Tflop/s for better performance. This optimization uses various implementations, including Metal, to achieve faster computations. The goal is to leverage Apple Silicon for efficient neural network training.

items.title: Silverback Imfura took a chance, and ended up alone
items.author: alex000kim
items.summary: Silverback Imfura left the Pablo group to form his own independent troop but ended up alone. He struggled with dominance shifts and was eventually isolated. His departure left the Pablo group with less disruption.

items.title: AMÁLIA and the future of European Portuguese LLMs
items.author: johnbarron
items.summary: In 2024, Portugal invested €5.5M in AMÁLIA, an open-source LLM for European Portuguese, continuing EuroLLM's pre-training. The project aims to enhance European Portuguese language representation. As of 2026, its impact and data usage remain to be seen.

items.title: Local AI needs to be the norm
items.author: cylo
items.summary: Local AI is increasingly important for privacy and efficiency, with significant advancements allowing on-device processing without reliance on cloud models. This trend emphasizes local data handling and minimizes server dependencies. Local AI is best suited for tasks transforming user-owned data.

items.title: CUDA-oxide: Nvidia's official Rust to CUDA compiler
items.author: adamnemecek
items.summary: CUDA-oxide is an experimental Rust-to-CUDA compiler from NVlabs, allowing GPU kernel writing in Rust without foreign language bindings. It compiles Rust code directly to PTX. It's currently in alpha.

items.title: Mass NPM Supply Chain Attack Hits TanStack, Mistral AI, and 170 Packages
items.author: birdculture
items.summary: On May 11, 2026, a large supply chain attack compromised over 170 npm packages and 2 PyPI packages, including TanStack and Mistral AI. The attack delivered malicious versions, but no maintainer accounts were compromised. The attack targeted both npm and PyPI registries.

items.title: Gmail registration now requires scanning a QR code and sending a text message
items.author: negura
items.summary: Gmail registration now requires scanning a QR code and sending an SMS for security verification. This method helps Google confirm your phone number and enhances account security. Some users report registration issues with the QR code.

items.title: Guitar tuner that uses phone accelerometer
items.author: adm4
items.summary: A guitar tuner app uses a phone's accelerometer to detect vibrations from guitar strings. It's a novel approach to tuning without a microphone. The app's effectiveness varies.

items.title: HDMI 2.1 Display Stream Compression (DSC) Ready for Amdgpu Linux Driver
items.author: WithinReason
items.summary: HDMI 2.1 Display Stream Compression (DSC) is now supported by the AMDGPU Linux driver. This update enhances video performance for AMD Radeon graphics cards. The latest driver release includes this feature.

items.title: Show HN: E2a – Open-source email gateway for AI agents
items.author: mnexa
items.text:
We were building an agent system and wanted email as a trigger. We decided to take it out and made it a standalone service.

The primary email features we wanted and used for our own agent system:

1. Email threading stays consistent with agent conversation threading

2. Human in the loop review for outbound emails (especially during testing phase)

3. Quick onboarding/offboarding email addresses for agents within minutes

4. Websocket for local agents and at-least-once webhook deliver
items.summary: E2a is an open-source email gateway for AI agents, offering authenticated email handling and integration features. It supports SPF/DKIM verification and HMAC-signed delivery. It is designed to trigger and coordinate AI agents via email.
